notes: Raised by issue #676 Phase 3 batch 2 ("broaden already-tested capability modules to their remaining untested public functions"). Covers names/ (christological_titles.py, divine_names.py, role_search.py) and reporting/ (export.py, profiles.py, theological_reports.py — charts.py was already fully covered, untouched). Also fixed 2 real bugs found while writing these tests: role_search.py's role_chart()/role_report() take a SUBJECT's Strong's number, not a verb's — the original test passed a verb's Strong's number, which silently returned an empty result (one test failed outright on the empty chart, the other passed vacuously on a loose text assertion); both now use a real subject (YHWH, H3068) and assert real data. unit_min_percent measured in an isolated venv matching CI's exact package list AND Python version (3.12, not the system default), with data/processed/ temporarily moved aside to match CI's fresh checkout (CI never builds it) — see the gotchas documented in docs/policies/test-coverage.md. Unchanged at 12.50% this batch since all new tests are integration-marked. full_min_percent measured in the regular fully-provisioned dev venv, raised 50.19% -> 53.84%. Remaining Phase 3 scope (lexical/, stems/, verbal_syntax/, intertextuality/, remaining ot/ modules, discourse/genre_compare.py + speaker.py) left for subsequent batches. Update only via `scripts/check_coverage.py --update-baseline`, in the same PR that earns the increase — see docs/policies/test-coverage.md.
